selection_method: Per-repository deterministic SHA-256 ordering of IDs; previous five model-evaluation tasks excluded from held-out selection. No issue or reference-patch content used for selection.
design: Same server, image, model, adapters and sampling; interleave configuration order by task. Report held-out and diagnostic outcomes separately, complete traces and provenance for all graded patches.
promotion_gate: No held-out or diagnostic resolution regression, source-only emitted patches, and trace evidence of shorter failed-call/reproduction loops. Resolution gains and unchanged counts with faster recovery must be reported separately; neither is statistically conclusive at this sample size.
required_controls: Unpatched failure/reference success plus snapshot import provenance for selected task repositories, including HTTPX. Previous model results are not fresh paired controls.

proposed_compute_ceiling.billable_resources: New isolated Spot A100 clone, temporary disk and snapshot; preserve original disk and remove only new resources.

scope_limit: Seven held-out tasks cover four repositories but are not a proportionally representative or statistically conclusive estimate.

control_replacement.authorization: User selected Replace the incompatible task after observing a legitimately skipped Pydantic-1 required test rejected by the grader under Pydantic 2.
control_replacement.rule: Next FastAPI ID in the original seeded ordering after the three originally selected IDs; no issue or reference-patch content inspected for replacement selection.
control_replacement.scope: Nine tasks, seven held-out, two diagnostic, four repositories; unchanged inference configuration and strict grader.
